theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_irp_squared_vandermonde_symmetric
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, MvPolynomial.IsSymmetric ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ij : Fin n × Fin n => ij.1 < ij.2)).prod (fun ij => ((MvPolynomial.X ij.1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℤ) - MvPolynomial.X ij.2) ^ 2))
